# FRAMEWORK-IMPROVEMENTS — suggestions for cap-evolve itself (cross-run)

NOT about this capability or this run's result — about what cap-evolve the FRAMEWORK should change so FUTURE runs (any capability, any project) go better: a confusing prompt section, a missing tool, a file you wished existed, a gate that felt wrong. Optional most iterations; add an entry whenever something about the framework itself (not the task) got in your way or surprised you.

<!-- cap-evolve:framework-improvements-append-below -->

## cand_0001
- The INSTRUCTIONS say "EMPTY SEED — the capability directory is EMPTY", but `my_skill/scripts/` already contained 14 passthrough tool wrappers. That contradiction cost time verifying. Please make the empty-seed banner reflect the actual on-disk state (passthrough-wrapper seed vs truly empty).
- For a tools-only capability, several failing clusters (pure ACTION-STALL / narrated-not-executed, premature human-transfer) are structurally unfixable from the tool surface — the tool cannot force the model to call it, and blocking escalation is an unbounded permission change. Consider letting a run co-optimize the prompt/policy capability alongside tools, or clearly marking such clusters as out-of-scope for the selected capability so the optimizer doesn't burn effort on them.
- `bench_repo/` was referenced by INSTRUCTIONS but absent in the working dir; the real backend was only findable under a separate cache path (skillberry-benchmarks). A working symlink or note would help.
